# oneuptime_slo_burn_rate_rule_data (Data Source)

Slo burn rate rule data data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oneuptime_slo_burn_rate_rule_data" "example" {
  name = "example-slo_burn_rate_rule_data"
}
```
